stage.name: Tight Game
stage.description:
When neither side is able to break the stalemate, the game goes to a penalty shootout, the ultimate test of skill and will.
<Winter Field> Friction is reduced, and enemies have increased Movement Speed.
<Penalty Shootout> Game is decided by penalty shootout if the two sides are tied when time runs out.
<Mercy Rule> First team to get a 5-goal lead wins.

tactical_team_shooter.name: Tactical Team Shooter
tactical_team_shooter.flavourText: The Tactical Team is known for its tactical acumen and superb tactical equipment. Tactical Team Shooters equipped with thermal-imaging goggles can shoot with unerring accuracy in any condition, which is why they prefer to play in fog.
abilities: Shoots quicker and aims in a direction where there are no <Positional Barriers>

elite_tactical_team_shooter.name: Elite Tactical Team Shooter
elite_tactical_team_shooter.flavourText: Elite members of the Tactical Team are said to have been baptized by fire in battle. Elite Tactical Team Shooters equipped with thermal-imaging goggles can shoot with unerring accuracy in any condition, which is why they prefer to play in fog.
abilities: Shoots quicker and aims in a direction where there are no <Positional Barriers>

tactical_team_goalie.name: Tactical Team Goalie
tactical_team_goalie.flavourText: The Tactical Team is known for its tactical acumen and superb tactical equipment. Tactical Team Goalies equipped with binocular goggles can find any gaps in the opposing formation and kick the ball directly into the opposing goal.
abilities: Kickoffs are more powerful and aims in a direction where there are no <Positional Barriers>

decisive_moment_ball.name: Decisive Moment Ball
decisive_moment_ball.flavourText: Football designed for penalty shootouts in order to enrich the match experience. The smart chip automatically shows the countdown, magnified to make it clear to both players and fans that the most exciting moment is upon us.
abilities: On your turn: 10s countdown, changes direction of shot when attacked during this time; fires automatically when the timer ends.
Enemy turn: Can be kicked by opposing players

elite_tactical_team_goalie.flavourText: Elite members of the Tactical Team are said to have been baptized by fire in battle. Elite Tactical Team Goalies equipped with binocular goggles can find any gaps in the opposing formation and kick the ball directly into the opposing goal.
abilities: Kickoffs are more powerful and aims in a direction where there are no <Positional Barriers>

elite_tactical_team_hitter.name: Elite Tactical Team Hitter
elite_tactical_team_hitter.flavourText: Elite members of the Tactical Team are said to have been baptized by fire in battle. Elite Tactical Team Hitters equipped with vital monitors and warning systems can quickly locate opposing players attempting to hurt their teammates. Watch out—they have already found you.
abilities: Prioritizes searching for your units that dealt damage to opposing players

fluffy_pink_balloon.name: Fluffy Pink Balloon
fluffy_pink_balloon.flavourText: A football that imitates a furry critter to enrich the match experience... Hey, where did it go? Okay, it's actually a real furry critter that's drifting through the air right now.
abilities: A very light football that can be easily moved.
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

abilities: Prioritizes searching for your units that dealt damage to opposing players

bloated_beetleball.name: Bloated Beetleball
bloated_beetleball.flavourText: An Originium beetle plays the part of the football. It sucks in air to expand rapidly when it feels threatened, to scare away predators, but this just makes it all the more adorable to those present.
abilities: Becomes bigger when kicked, requiring more damage to move
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

perpetual_rebounder.name: Perpetual Rebounder
perpetual_rebounder.flavourText: A football inspired by an extremely unstable entity to enrich the match experience. It is as unpredictable as its inspiration, and has already been bouncing all over the field for half an hour... Somebody stop it, please!
abilities: Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

rma70_spikeball.name: RMA70 Spikeball
rma70_spikeball.flavourText: A football that imitates RMA70 minerals to enrich the match experience. Its spikes are surprisingly benign. Players who have tried it say that kicking it is a highly interactive experience.
abilities: Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.
